headline: A routine deal step: shareholders of First Hawaiian and TriCo approved the agreed merger
reasoning: Source: the companies' joint release on GlobeNewswire (dated 10/29), relayed by Benzinga 09:02 ET: 'their respective stockholders and shareholders have approved the proposed acquisition of TriCo by First Hawaiian ... expect the transaction to close later in 2026'.
What changed: an expected vote passed. Pre-market on the consolidated tape: 53.40 vs 53.455, -0.1%.
objections: Expected shareholder vote on an announced deal.
